description: CaNaAlSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.93 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.81 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.79 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom.
